==Introduction==
If you talk to [[Osman]] after completing the [[Prince Ali Rescue]] quest (or [[Selim]] after completing [[Beneath Cursed Sands]]), you will find out that he wants to get [[sq'irkjuice]], but the sorceress with whom he normally deals now refuses to give it to him. To this end, he will enlist you to steal [[sq'irk]] fruit from her garden. You can get to the garden from the [[apprentice]] who works in the house near the [[Shantay Pass]]. After completing the following steps once, you can immediately right-click Teleport at the Apprentice the next time.

Step-by-step:
{{Checklist|
*Talk to [[Osman]] (completing [[Prince Ali Rescue]] is required) or [[Selim]] (after completion of [[Beneath Cursed Sands]]) and ask him if there is something you can do. {{Chat option|1|1Where do I get sq'irks?|2Thanks for the information.}}
*Go to the house north-east of the [[Shantay Pass]] and talk to the [[apprentice]]. {{Chat option|2Surely there must be upsides to the task?|2Oh you can talk to me. I can see you're having a bad day.|2A sympathetic ear can do wonders.|3You mentioned something about the garden.|1Wow, cast the spell of me. It will be good Magic training for you.}}
}}
